messages:
maya: Quick design note — the regression heatmap legend on the Prompt Sets > Eval run page is hard to read for colorblind users. Screenshot: https://redwood.mock/fig/heatmap-legend.png

maya: Two main problems: (1) the red/orange/green stops collapse for deuteranopia, (2) the label 'Regression score' is ambiguous about direction.

tom: +1 on both. Can we swap to a colorblind-safe palette (Okabe-Ito or ColorBrewer) and add patterns for exported PNGs?

sasha: A11y flag: contrast ratio for the tiny legend text is 2.3:1 vs. required 4.5:1. Either increase font weight/size or darken text. Also need explicit aria labels for each swatch.

alex: Implementation note: legend is SVG and generated from the eval run summary. Adding patterns is doable (SVG <pattern>), but it will add a few KB. Adding a 1px stroke around swatches is low cost and helps perception.

maya: Mockup attached here: https://redwood.mock/fig/heatmap-mock-2.png — I tried Okabe-Ito + thin stroke. Also propose copy change: 'Delta vs baseline (lower is better)'. The current "Regression score" trips non-ML folks.

design-bot: a11y-scan: heatmap legend swatches #f28b82 and #fbbc04 fail color contrast when used with white text.

katie: Editorial nit: prefer verbs that product folks understand — use 'Improved / Regressed' instead of positive/negative. Also add an explanatory tooltip: 'Delta vs baseline — negative = improvement, positive = regression' (or flip sign if we standardize lower = better).

tom: For prototyping I'll try Okabe-Ito + stroke + optional hatches for export. Quick CSS to help now: `.legend-swatch { stroke: #111; stroke-width: 1px; }`

sasha: For screen readers: aria-label example: `aria-label=\"Legend: Very regressed, delta 4.2\"` or better: `aria-label=\"Legend swatch: Very regressed (delta > 3)\"`. Each swatch should be focusable (tabindex=0) and read its label.

maya: Decision proposal: use Okabe-Ito palette in UI, add 1px stroke, increase legend text weight to 600, update copy to 'Delta vs baseline — lower is better', add hover tooltip explaining direction, and include hatches for exported PNGs.

katie: Copy tweak: use an em-dash: 'Delta vs baseline — lower is better' (looks cleaner). Also change tooltip short form to 'Lower = improvement'.

tom: I'll build a quick prototype branch and post screenshots Monday morning. Will include before/after contrast numbers.

alex: FYI: if we change sign semantics (lower = better), we need to flip existing sort order and any saved alerts. Might be a config toggle.

sasha: Action items: @tom prototype, @sasha add aria labels & keyboard focus, @katie update copy strings in i18n, @maya confirm before ship.

maya: Sounds good — thanks everyone. Small follow-up: can we add an explicit legend export option (SVG/PNG) so customers can embed accessible legends in reports?

tom: noted, adding export toggle to prototype.

katie: One final microcopy: change 'Very regressed' -> 'Severely regressed' (more explicit).

maya: Love that. Thanks! :sparkles:

maya: (cc @design-bot for a11y scan re-run once prototype is up)
